2014_spells.thunderclap.description: You create a burst of thunderous sound that can be heard up to 100 feet away. Each creature other than you within range must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 1d6 thunder damage.
2014_spells.thunderclap.effectSummary: Deal 1d6 thunder damage to a target within Self (5-foot radius)
2014_spells.thunderclap.fullDescription: Using 1 action, you create a burst of thunderous sound that can be heard up to 100 feet away. On a failed save, a creature takes 1d6 thunder damage; Each creature other than you within range must make a Constitution saving throw; roll a d20, add the CON modifier, and compare it with your spell save spell save DC; The spell's damage increases by 1d6 when you reach 5th level (2d6), 11th level (3d6), and 17th level (4d6). The effect happens immediately and then ends.
